boss_rules.intro_text: The Abyss Siren is holding the floor exit. Step in to finish the excursion or extract before committing.
boss_rules.intro_text_zh: 深渊海妖挡住了楼层出口。现在踏进去就要打完这场远征，若不想立刻决战，就先在外面撤离。
boss_rules.defeat_text: The Siren cache is loose. Take the last room reward and ride the harbor lights home.
boss_rules.defeat_text_zh: 海妖缓存已经松动。拿上最后一个房间奖励，然后顺着港口灯火回航。

phase_texts_zh.phase_1: 机制考验 I：先压住噪声
phase_texts_zh.phase_2: 机制考验 II：点亮真正核心
phase_texts_zh.phase_3: 机制考验 III：躲开横扫
phase_texts_zh.phase_4: 机制考验 IV：打断祭仪召唤

boss_rules.intro_text: The ritual core is exposed. Break the Siren's tempo, survive the add waves, and secure the return route in one push.
boss_rules.intro_text_zh: 祭仪核心已经外露。压住海妖节奏、扛过增援波次，然后一口气把返航路线打通。
boss_rules.defeat_text: The tide has gone quiet. Claim the last reward, pocket the deeper haul, and head back under harbor lights.
boss_rules.defeat_text_zh: 潮鸣已经沉下去。拿上最后奖励，收好更深层的战利品，然后顺着港灯回航。

phase_texts_zh.phase_1: 机制考验 I：压低噪声，别让海妖进入强势节奏
phase_texts_zh.phase_2: 机制考验 II：照出真身，别把输出丢在假回波上
phase_texts_zh.phase_3: 机制考验 III：读线躲开横扫，再找回输出窗口
phase_texts_zh.phase_4: 机制考验 IV：先清祭仪仆从，再打穿海妖护盾
